description:
Ready to go from graduate to trusted advisor for Europe’s best-known brands in just 12 months? Expect a steep learning curve, real responsibility, and hands-on experience working with AI every day.

💚 About us

Our mission is to help marketing teams unlock their full growth potential with AI. Most companies still judge their marketing by last-click. Our AI-powered attribution shows which channels actually drive revenue, and our platform automatically moves ad budgets to where they have the most impact. As a Zurich-based AI scale-up of around 30 people, we support leading European brands in e-commerce, telecommunications, banking, insurance and energy.

🚀 Your mission

Get future-proof. In our 12-month traineeship you learn, at the intersection of marketing, analytics and AI, how modern marketing is measured and optimized with algorithms. You will have a dedicated expert buddy to show you the ropes. You won't learn how AI replaces your job, but how to work with it and achieve more. After one year, you look after your own clients and move into a permanent role in our Customer Success & Account Management team.

🗺️ Your year at Nexoya

  • Foundations (Months 1 to 3): You learn how digital advertising works, from search to social to display, using Google, Meta, TikTok and Snapchat as examples. Then you dive into analytics and attribution, understand how our algorithms optimize budgets, and get your personal AI toolkit.

  • Applied (Months 4 to 8): Together with your buddy you look after your first clients and lead your first calls yourself. You also spend time in marketing, sales and product, and join a sprint with our Founder & CEO.

  • Ownership (Months 9 to 12): You look after clients fully on your own and take responsibility for your own projects.

🧑‍💻 Your tasks

  • Analyze cross-channel performance data (Google Ads, Meta, TikTok, Snap, etc.)

  • Master attribution, marketing mix modeling and incrementality, and explain them clearly to our clients

  • Prepare, interpret and present the budget optimizations from our platform

  • Work with AI tools every day for analysis, reporting and client meeting preparation

  • Understand what a client really needs, challenge assumptions with data and turn insights into clear recommendations, in German and English

  • Own projects that move our team and our platform forward

🎯 What you bring

  • You are at the start of your career, eager, like taking responsibility and want to learn fast

  • Enthusiasm for AI and analytics: you don't need to be a developer, but you should want to work with AI every day

  • A completed or soon-to-be-completed degree in business, data science, marketing or a related field

  • Enjoy working with numbers and data, for example in Excel or Google Sheets

  • Fluent in German and English is a must, Italian is a plus

  • A plus: your own AI projects, an internship in performance marketing, first experience with Claude, SQL, Python or BI tools

Why Nexoya?

✨ Future-proof skills: AI, marketing and analytics in one program

✨ A clear plan with fixed milestones, a personal buddy and regular development talks. You also start together with a second trainee

✨ A permanent contract from day one, plus a fixed salary increase and equity in Nexoya (ESOP) once you complete the traineeship

✨ A personal learning budget, for example for Google Ads or Meta certifications

✨ A real AI-first culture. Experiment, automate and share what you build, and work with MCPs, coworkers and agents

✨ A team you’ll love working with, an office just a few minutes’ walk from Zurich main station and the flexibility to work from home 3 days/week

✨ Twice a year the whole team travels somewhere special for our Strategy Days (so far Lenzerheide, Engelberg, Helsinki, Berlin and Belgrade)

title: Customer Care Specialist
description:
Making preventive health the default for every human in Europe

 

The mission

At Lucis, we believe healthcare should be preventive, not reactive. We’re building the OS for human longevity to help people add more healthy years to their lives. You can read more about who we are and how we work here.

 

The role

Health is complex, personal, and deeply important to our members. As the voice of Lucis clients, you support them throughout their health journey and own member happiness end to end.

With rapid member growth, we are hiring our first dedicated Customer Care Team Specialist. You will own the member experience end-to-end, stabilize our operational metrics, and build and manage a world-class support team.

What you will own

  • Member support: Resolve member and lab partner inquiries via chat, email and phone, with warmth, precision and a sense of urgency.

  • Phone-first when it matters: Pick up the phone whenever a situation calls for a human voice: a delayed result, a stressful moment, a confused member.

  • Know your boundaries: Work hand in hand with our medical team and know exactly when to escalate a health question rather than answer it yourself.

  • Voice of the member: Spot recurring issues and turn them into clear, structured feedback for the product and ops teams.

  • Contribute to projects: Take part in initiatives that improve the member experience, like rebuilding our Help Center, designing proactive care for lab delays, or automating repetitive workflows with AI.

 

About you

You’re passionate about the future of human health and want your work to help people stay healthy for longer. You move quickly from idea to execution, take full ownership of what you build, and work best with talented people who care as much as you do.

You thrive in fast‑moving environments, learn by doing, and value feedback as a way to continuously improve. You use AI the way others use a calculator: naturally, to go faster and think bigger.

 

You’ll fit in well if

  • Experience: 1+ years in B2C customer care, support, hospitality, or any role where you dealt directly with customers. Strong recent graduates with relevant experience are welcome too.

  • Bilingual: Fluent in both English and French, written and spoken.

  • People-first energy: You bring genuine warmth and empathy to every interaction, and you turn routine support into memorable experiences.

  • Rigorous precision: Exceptional attention to detail, with zero tolerance for misquotes, wrong information or operational errors. In health, accuracy is care.

  • Builder mindset: When something breaks twice, your instinct is to fix the root cause, not just the ticket.

Nice to have

  • Support tooling: You've used Intercom or similar support tools.

  • AI automation: You've already used AI tools to automate part of your work.

  • Startup mindset: You thrive in early-stage environments with high autonomy, rapid execution and clear communication.

 

The process

  • Intro call, culture & role fit (20 min)

  • Case study interview (30-60 min)

  • Deep dive and team chat, on-site (2 hours)

  • Reference calls

How we work

We work together from our Paris hub. We’re passionate about what we’re building and believe the fastest way to create something exceptional is side by side. We’re open to relocation support for the right individuals, and we welcome missionaries who travel to work with us in Paris on a regular basis.

  • Rigor without ego: Audits, science, and code all deserve the same high bar.

  • Radical ownership: Feedback loops are short; everyone contributes to building the best version of Lucis.

  • Velocity over perfection: We ship daily and prefer a good decision today over a perfect one next week.

title: Deployment Strategist, AI Solutions
description:
Deployment Strategist, AI Solutions

London, with travel to NYC and client sites

Who A.Team is?

A.Team builds the agentic operating system for the enterprise. Every company is being told AI will change how it works, and few are seeing it happen. We’re here to change that. We build AI systems that capture what a company knows as work happens, carry it across teams and decisions, and get smarter with every outcome. We pair them with top AI talent who embed with our customers to make sure those systems get adopted and keep improving. Today we’re focused on consumer packaged goods. Global CPG marketing teams use A.Team to act on cultural trends as they happen, optimize campaigns and media spend, and turn commercial and pricing signals into clear decisions. We’re proven in production with Fortune 500 brands and partner with Google Cloud, Microsoft, Anthropic and OpenAI.

About the Role

We're looking for an experienced enterprise transformation and delivery leader to own the end-to-end success of one of A.Team's most strategic enterprise clients.

You will lead a complex, multi-workstream AI transformation program, working closely with senior client executives and A.Team's product, engineering, and delivery teams. Your responsibility is to translate business priorities into an actionable roadmap, drive execution across teams, ensure successful adoption, and deliver measurable business impact.

This is a highly visible leadership role that combines strategic thinking, hands-on execution, and executive relationship management. You will be the single point of accountability for the overall success of the client program—from defining priorities and aligning stakeholders to ensuring solutions are delivered, adopted, and generating value.

You'll work closely with the Account Executive, who owns the commercial relationship, renewals, and expansion, while you own delivery execution and client outcomes.

We're looking for someone who has successfully led large-scale enterprise transformation or technology implementation programs, can navigate complex organizations, and knows how to turn ambitious strategies into real-world results.

What You'll Do

  • Own End-to-End Client Delivery: Take full accountability for the successful delivery of a strategic enterprise client program, from defining priorities and planning through implementation, adoption, and measurable business impact. Ensure all workstreams deliver against agreed objectives, timelines, and quality standards.

  • Lead Cross-Functional Execution: Coordinate product, engineering, PMs, and AIOps teams to deliver as one integrated program. Set priorities, manage dependencies and risks, resolve escalations, and ensure clear ownership and accountability across teams.

  • Define and Drive the Deployment Roadmap: Work with client stakeholders to translate business objectives into a prioritized roadmap of AI use cases. Identify high-impact opportunities, validate them quickly with our Pathfinder team, and continuously evolve the roadmap based on business needs and results.

  • Ensure Successful Implementation: Oversee the deployment of AI solutions, from initial pilots through production rollout and ongoing operations. Proactively identify and remove blockers, manage delivery risks, and ensure solutions meet both business and technical requirements.

  • Drive Adoption and Change Management: Ensure deployed solutions become embedded in the client's day-to-day workflows. Work with business stakeholders to drive organizational alignment, overcome resistance, address training needs, and maximize adoption.

  • Deliver Measurable Business Value: Define success metrics and business cases for each initiative. Track performance, adoption, and ROI, ensuring the program delivers tangible business outcomes rather than simply shipping technology.

  • Lead Executive Stakeholder Relationships: Serve as the primary delivery counterpart to senior client executives. Build trusted relationships, align stakeholders across functions, manage expectations, lead executive reviews, and navigate complex organizational dynamics.

  • Partner with the Account Executive: Work closely with the AE, who owns the commercial relationship, renewals, and expansion. Surface new opportunities, provide evidence of delivered value, and ensure alignment between client priorities, delivery commitments, and commercial objectives.

  • Build a Scalable Delivery Playbook: Capture lessons learned, establish best practices, and develop repeatable processes that can be applied across future enterprise deployments.

Must-Haves

  • Enterprise Transformation Leadership: 8+ years of experience leading large-scale digital transformation, technology implementation, or innovation programs for major enterprises. You've owned complex programs from strategy through execution and delivered measurable business outcomes. Experience may come from management consulting, enterprise technology companies, or in-house transformation leadership. This is the most important requirement for the role.

  • End-to-End Program Ownership: Proven ability to lead complex, multi-workstream programs, coordinating cross-functional teams, managing competing priorities, resolving dependencies, and driving execution. You take full accountability for outcomes, even when teams don't report directly to you.

  • Executive Stakeholder Management: A track record of building trusted relationships with senior enterprise executives, navigating complex organizations, aligning stakeholders with competing interests, and influencing decisions. You're equally comfortable in the boardroom and working hands-on with delivery teams.

  • AI and Technical Fluency: Strong understanding of how enterprise AI and technology solutions are designed, built, integrated, deployed, and operated. You can engage confidently with engineers and technical leaders, challenge assumptions, evaluate trade-offs, and translate technical complexity into business implications. You don't need to be an engineer.

  • Business Acumen and Value Realization: Ability to translate business objectives into actionable plans, define meaningful success metrics, build compelling business cases, and demonstrate measurable value through adoption, operational improvements, and ROI.

  • Decisiveness and Problem-Solving: Strong judgment and a bias for action. You can navigate ambiguity, make difficult trade-offs, resolve complex problems, and keep teams focused on what matters most.

  • London-Based: Based in London, with the ability to work on-site with enterprise clients and travel to New York and other client locations as needed.

Nice-to-Haves

  • CPG, marketing or commercial-function experience

  • Experience driving adoption of AI or agentic tools inside large enterprises

  • Experience at an early-stage company where you built the playbook, not just ran it

  • Background spanning consulting and product or delivery leadership

A.Team is an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.

title: Ops Associate
description:
At Parallel, we build AI agents to help healthcare facilities automate their administrative processes and unlock additional revenue, starting with medical coding.


Today, up to 25% of healthcare spending is lost in manual, repetitive administrative work. Legacy software hasn’t helped, it’s made things slower, more complex, and more frustrating for care teams.

We believe AI agents can change that. Our technology combines Large Language Models with system-level automation to handle real work inside existing hospital tools. No integrations, no disruption.

Our first agent automates coding workflows and frees up time for medical staff to focus on patients.

We launched in 2024, are backed by top investors (Index, Frst, Y Combinator, Hexa, Kima Ventures, Better Angle), and we’re just getting started.

 

The future of healthcare isn’t just digital — it’s automated. Come help us build it !

The role

At Parallel, we work with a team of 25+ freelance TIMs (medical information technicians) on different tasks, in particular retrieving medical documents from our partner facilities’ software. This is a core part of Parallel. With fast, secure access to our partner facilities’ data, we code the first hospital stays within a few days and prove Parallel’s ROI. Then we automate document extraction so we can scale.

As Ops Associate, you support the Ops team on managing freelancers and on cross-functional Ops projects. You take ownership of critical operational topics end to end and contribute directly to Parallel’s growth. You work daily with our Head of Ops, the Deployment Strategists, Customer Care and our freelance TIMs.

You’re in charge of staffing and managing our network of freelance TIMs and become their main point of contact, working directly with our Head of Ops. You also work on cross-functional projects that structure Ops as Parallel scales. It’s a chance to see first-hand how a generative AI solution is deployed in hospitals, and to experience a startup’s scale-up from the inside.

What you’ll do

Staffing and management of freelance TIMs

You’re responsible for the network of freelance TIMs who support our clients. You make sure the right person is on the right assignment, at the right time, within a compliant framework.

  • Sourcing and recruiting: identify, qualify and recruit new TIMs based on needs (specialties, facilities, volume).

  • Staffing assignments: assign TIMs to client accounts, anticipate workload peaks and manage priorities.

  • Onboarding: train new TIMs on the Parallel tool and our ways of working.

  • Monitoring: centralize assignment tracking and manage the team’s performance.

  • Contracts and compliance: keep freelance contracts up to date, in line with our ISO 27001 and HDS requirements (data access, confidentiality).

Cross-functional Ops projects

You support the Ops team on cross-functional projects to make processes more robust and scalable. For example, you could:

  • Compliance and security: contribute to the ISO 27001 and HDS certification project on the Ops side (registers, evidence, access reviews, contracts).

  • Processes and documentation: keep client training notes up to date and improve internal playbooks (deployment, support).

Who we’re looking for

  • You’re looking for your first permanent job, or possibly an end-of-studies internship (with the goal of staying with us on a permanent contract).

  • You’re rigorous: you organize yourself, prioritize, and follow your topics through to the end.

  • You have strong people skills: you can adapt to profiles very different from yours, explain technical topics and bring a team along.

  • You’re comfortable in a tech environment and like understanding how software works so you can help others use it.

  • You’re autonomous: when you’re given an assignment, you figure out how to set up the right processes and resources to get it done.

Why join us?

  • Real impact: our agents free hospital teams from administrative work.

  • A central role: you work with Ops, Product, Tech and the field teams.

  • Room to grow: we’re hiring for this role to help someone grow with us over time.

  • The right time: Series A closed, product already used by ~100 hospitals, a fast-growing team.

  • The package: Alan health insurance, Swile, Apple equipment, 50% of transport covered, a team event every month and two off-sites a year.

  • Our offices: Paris 2nd arrondissement, boulevard de Sébastopol.

The process

  1. Call with Léa, Talent Lead (30 min)

  2. Call with Clémentine, Head of Ops and your future manager (30 min)

  3. Case study with Clémentine and Jules and meeting with Paul, CEO

  4. Offer

We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV.

If you're drawn to what we're building but don't meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet 100% of the criteria. If that's you, please don't let that hold you back. We'd love to receive your application.

Bedrijfsbeschrijving

ITS Benelux maakt deel uit van de internationale ITS Group, een organisatie die al meer dan 35 jaar actief is en klanten ondersteunt in Europa, Noord-Amerika en daarbuiten.

Maar wat je vooral merkt als collega, is dat we ondanks onze internationale omvang een nuchtere en persoonlijke organisatie zijn gebleven.

We werken hard, helpen elkaar, vieren successen samen en geloven dat de beste ideeën ontstaan wanneer mensen zich prettig voelen op hun werk.

Hier ben je geen nummer, maar een belangrijk onderdeel van het team.

Voel je vrij om its-group.com en printandcopycontrol.com te bezoeken om meer te weten te komen over ons bedrijf en productportfolio.

iTS is gecertificeerd volgens de ISO 9001:2015- en ISO/IEC 27001:2022-normen.

Bedrijfswaarden

Klantgericht: We streven ernaar om te zorgen dat aan de behoeften van onze klanten worden voldaan en overtroffen, en bouwen sterke, langdurige relaties op.

Flexibel & Loyaal: We investeren tijd, energie en middelen in het koesteren van onze relaties, met als doel langdurig succes.

Internationaal team met een gezinsgeest: Onze bedrijfscultuur hecht waarde aan samenwerking, waardering en persoonlijke ontwikkeling, en biedt een waardevolle omgeving waar iedereen kan floreren.

ITS is niet:

Arrogant

Arrogantie laat mensen geloven dat ze altijd het beste weten. Het stopt het constante leren dat succes vereist. Wij zien arrogantie als het begin van het einde van elke organisatie.
